outbox_events_lease_consistent.name: outbox_events_lease_consistent
outbox_events_lease_consistent.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'PROCESSING') = ("outbox_events"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox_events"."locked_until" IS NOT NULL)

audit_logs_ids_nonempty.name: audit_logs_ids_nonempty
audit_logs_ids_nonempty.value: length("audit_logs"."actor_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("audit_logs"."entity_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

variants_sale_window.name: variants_sale_window
variants_sale_window.value: "product_variants"."sale_ends_at" is null or "product_variants"."sale_starts_at" is null or "product_variants"."sale_ends_at" > "product_variants"."sale_starts_at"

variants_sale_window_needs_price.name: variants_sale_window_needs_price
variants_sale_window_needs_price.value: "product_variants"."sale_price" is not null or ("product_variants"."sale_starts_at" is null and "product_variants"."sale_ends_at" is null)

mfa_recovery_approved_fields.name: mfa_recovery_approved_fields
mfa_recovery_approved_fields.value: "mfa_recovery_requests"."status" not in ('APPROVED','COMPLETED') or ("mfa_recovery_requests"."approved_by" is not null and "mfa_recovery_requests"."approved_at" is not null and "mfa_recovery_requests"."approval_expires_at" is not null)

mfa_recovery_completed_fields.name: mfa_recovery_completed_fields
mfa_recovery_completed_fields.value: "mfa_recovery_requests"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("mfa_recovery_requests"."completed_by" is not null and "mfa_recovery_requests"."completed_at" is not null)

digital_codes_status_links.name: digital_codes_status_links
digital_codes_status_links.value:
("digital_codes"."status" = 'AVAILABLE' and "digital_codes"."reservation_id" is null and "digital_codes"."order_item_ref" is null and "digital_codes"."reserved_until" is null)
       or ("digital_codes"."status" = 'RESERVED' and "digital_codes"."reservation_id" is not null and "digital_codes"."order_item_ref" is null and "digital_codes"."reserved_until" is not null)
       or ("digital_codes"."status" = 'SOLD' and "digital_codes"."order_item_ref" is not null and "digital_codes"."sold_at" is not null)
       or ("digital_codes"."status" in ('VOID','QUARANTINED'))

ledger_accounts_normal_side_matches_type.name: ledger_accounts_normal_side_matches_type
ledger_accounts_normal_side_matches_type.value: "ledger_accounts"."normal_side" = CASE WHEN ("ledger_accounts"."type" IN ('ASSET','EXPENSE')) <> "ledger_accounts"."contra" THEN 'DEBIT' ELSE 'CREDIT' END

payments_one_target.name: payments_one_target
payments_one_target.value: ("payments"."purpose" = 'ORDER' and "payments"."order_ref" is not null and "payments"."topup_ref" is null) or ("payments"."purpose" = 'WALLET_TOPUP' and "payments"."topup_ref" is not null and "payments"."order_ref" is null)

payments_succeeded_verified.name: payments_succeeded_verified
payments_succeeded_verified.value: "payments"."status" <> 'SUCCEEDED' or ("payments"."verified_at" is not null and "payments"."verified_amount" = "payments"."amount" and "payments"."gateway_ref" is not null)

payments_pending_has_ref.name: payments_pending_has_ref
payments_pending_has_ref.value: "payments"."status" not in ('PENDING','VERIFYING') or "payments"."gateway_ref" is not null

wallet_adjustments_decided.name: wallet_adjustments_decided
wallet_adjustments_decided.value: "wallet_adjustments"."status" = 'REQUESTED' or ("wallet_adjustments"."decided_by" is not null and "wallet_adjustments"."decided_at" is not null and char_length(btrim(coalesce("wallet_adjustments"."decision_reason", ''))) >= 5)

wallet_topups_completed.name: wallet_topups_completed
wallet_topups_completed.value: "wallet_topups"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("wallet_topups"."ledger_txn_id" is not null and "wallet_topups"."completed_at" is not null and "wallet_topups"."payment_id" is not null)
